questions.cardText:
[Medical Sciences] Which of the following can be a non-inflammatory cause of itchiness in eczema?
A. Viruses B. Bacteria C. Fungus
Answer: B. Recent research has shown that a type of bacteria can release a chemical that directly acts on nerve cells in the skin, leading to itchiness.
questions.de: Welches Bakterium löst, wie 2023 gezeigt wurde, Juckreiz direkt aus, indem es ein Enzym (die V8-Protease) freisetzt, das auf Nervenzellen der Haut wirkt – eine nicht entzündliche Ursache des Juckreizes bei Ekzemen?
questions.en: Which bacterium was shown in 2023 to cause itch directly, by releasing an enzyme (the V8 protease) that acts on nerve cells in the skin, a non-inflammatory cause of itching in eczema?

timeline.labelEn: A study in Cell shows Staphylococcus aureus drives itch through its V8 protease acting on PAR1 on nerve cells
timeline.labelDe: Eine Studie in Cell zeigt, dass Staphylococcus aureus über seine V8-Protease und den PAR1-Rezeptor der Nervenzellen Juckreiz auslöst

questions.notes: The card answers only "bacteria"; the research (Deng et al., Cell 2023) names Staphylococcus aureus, so the open question asks for that species. Accept "golden staph" / "Staph aureus".

questions.cardText:
[Religious Studies] What is a mezuzah?
A. A prayer shawl
B. A scroll containing biblical verses
C. A ceremonial cup
Answer: B. A mezuzah contains parchment inscribed with verses from the Torah. It’s placed inside a decorative case and affixed to the doorframes of many Jewish people’s homes. Many Jewish people touch or kiss the mezuzah when passing through the doorway as a sign of respect and devotion.
questions.de: Wie heißt das mit Versen aus der Tora beschriftete Pergament, das Juden in einer kleinen Kapsel am Türpfosten ihrer Wohnungen anbringen und beim Durchgehen oft berühren oder küssen?
questions.en: What is the name of the parchment inscribed with Torah verses that Jews place in a small case on the doorposts of their homes, and often touch or kiss when passing through?

timeline.labelEn: The core of Deuteronomy, whose verses command the mezuzah (Deut. 6:9), is composed in Jerusalem
timeline.labelDe: Der Kern des Deuteronomiums, dessen Verse die Mesusa gebieten (Dtn 6,9), entsteht in Jerusalem

questions.notes: The verses are Deuteronomy 6:4–9 and 11:13–21 (part of the Shema). German spellings Mesusa / Mezuza both occur.
